impressions.text: The work addressed task-PR linking, moving from generated PR-body text to GitHub Development relations after owner feedback that the link must be native.
The worker reported broad test and quality-check coverage, including a final run of 838 tests across 51 files after integrating dev.
The orchestrator’s review caught the mismatch with the requested native linkage, and the worker reworked the solution to use add/remove Development relations instead of PR-description text.
The worker paused for authenticated recordings of the GraphQL mutation shapes; the orchestrator supplied live add/remove captures and confirmed duplicate-add idempotence.
Live smoke confirmed linking, unlinking, and restoring the Development relation on PR 74, while visual confirmation of the Development panel was not claimed by the worker.
